responsibility: Implements a late GIMPLE vector-selection lowering pass that rewrites vector-specific expressions into target-oriented internal functions. In particular it expands VEC_COND_EXPR into IFN_VCOND, IFN_VCONDU, IFN_VCONDEQ, or IFN_VCOND_MASK calls depending on available expanders and rewrites ARRAY_REF(VIEW_CONVERT_EXPR) stores into IFN_VEC_SET sequences, then runs simple DCE support on affected SSA names so vector code is in a form suitable for later expansion.
